_comment: Hand-written meanings that beat the generated ones. WordNet orders senses by corpus frequency, which is not always the reading a player expects - MEN as 'the force of workers available', BANK as a river slope. Anything listed here replaces the generated entry outright. Same shape as word_definitions.json, so add a word, a part of speech and one clear sentence.

senses.meaning: a business that keeps and lends money
a playing card with a single mark, usually the highest in its suit
a tool with a toothed blade for cutting wood or metal
a path or track through open country
the form of 'be' used with you, we and they
the past form of 'be' used with I, he, she and it
a huge ball of burning gas seen as a point of light in the night sky
